workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The approved Beat Plan is a compact single-beat movement that does not need long-work support.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests sequence, series, long-form expansion, or dependent follow-up parts.

beats.one_move_summary: A figure remains at the doorway, feeling the pull to cross without crossing.
beats.after_state: The figure remains suspended at the threshold.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A lit doorway and a key suggest entry, welcome, or resolution.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The figure does not enter; the light makes the choice feel more dangerous.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The expected symbol of welcome becomes a source of paralysis.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Tenderness turns into threat without losing tenderness.

beats.intended_feeling: the ache of being close to release but unable to choose it
beats.emotional_payload: The force is in the refusal to resolve.

tension_profile.name: Stillness / Motion
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the body frozen while the possibility of crossing stays alive

tension_profile.name: Control / Surrender
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the key feel like agency that cannot be used

source_evidence: The reference centers on an uncrossed doorway.

pivot_options.label: residue
pivot_options.next_move: Stay after the decision is deferred.
pivot_options.rationale: This would extend the threshold into aftermath without resolving it.

medium_translation_notes.video: A short held shot with almost no crossing motion.
medium_translation_notes.sound: A suspended build that never releases.
medium_translation_notes.text: A fragment that stops before the decision.
medium_translation_notes.mixed_media: Image holds the threshold while sound carries pressure.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wanted the unresolved threshold to survive.

tension_points.summary: Stillness that feels ready to move.
tension_points.intended_feeling: suspense held in the body without release
source_evidence: The figure is close to action but does not act.

traceability_notes.note: Stillness and motion are both active.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: welcome becomes danger without losing tenderness

traceability_notes.note: The artist wanted the unresolved threshold and tender danger to survive compression.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: A single compressed beat should hold strong internal contrast between possible movement and refused action.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: For single-beat work, adjacent shift is not required, but internal contrast must be visible and reviewable.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the beat reads as a factual doorway scene without strong stillness/motion or control/surrender pressure.

arc_summary.turn: The threshold becomes the whole event.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: A single beat is enough because resolution would betray the Artist Meaning.

traceability_summary.note: The Beat Plan uses the recommended single_beat mode.
